company.name: Brightline IT Services Ltd
company.description: A 30-person managed service provider in Cardiff supporting around 80 small and medium businesses: helpdesk, Microsoft 365, firewalls, backups and cyber security. Clients email about outages, new starters and leavers, licence renewals, invoices and security worries. A recent phishing campaign is targeting clients, and the company is migrating clients to a new backup platform.
